references.title: New Polynomial-Depth Res(⊕) Lower Bounds
references.note: States that no superpolynomial unrestricted Res(⊕) size lower bounds are known and develops depth-restricted progress.

references.title: Exponential Lower Bounds on the Size of ResLin Proofs of Nearly Quadratic Depth
references.note: Proves strong lower bounds for proofs of depth O(N^{2-epsilon}), not unrestricted dag-like Res(⊕).

references.title: Lower bounds for regular resolution over parities
references.note: Proves exponential lower bounds for regular Res(⊕) while describing unrestricted dag-like lower bounds as open.

references.title: Characterizing Propositional Proofs as Non-Commutative Formulas
references.note: Describes superpolynomial Frege lower bounds as a major open problem.

references.title: The Surprising Power of Constant Depth Algebraic Proofs
references.note: Shows strong simulations by constant-depth algebraic proofs and records the lack of significant AC^0[p]-Frege lower bounds.

references.title: Hard CNF Instances for Ideal Proof Systems
references.note: Proves CNF lower bounds for roABP-IPS and explains that the full-IPS CNF frontier remains open.

references.title: Lower Bounds against the Ideal Proof System in Finite Fields
references.note: Establishes lower bounds for restricted IPS fragments over fixed finite fields and explains the connection to AC^0[p]-Frege.

references.title: Separation Results for Constant-Depth and Multilinear Ideal Proof Systems
references.note: Gives separation theorems for IPS subsystems, not unrestricted full IPS.

references.title: Knowledge Compilation, Width and Quantification
references.note: Documents the algorithmic importance of bounded-width compiled representations and the cost of quantification.

references.title: A Short Proof that the Extension Complexity of the Correlation Polytope Grows Exponentially
references.note: Provides an explicit exponential linear extension-complexity lower bound relevant to restricted lift models.

references.title: Lower bounds on the size of semidefinite programming relaxations
references.note: Gives superpolynomial SDP extension-complexity lower bounds for explicit polytopes and relates polynomial-size SDPs to constant-level sum-of-squares for approximation.

references.title: On Semi-Algebraic Proofs and Algorithms
references.note: Studies semi-algebraic proofs, extended formulations, and separations relevant to exact relaxation claims.

claim_boundary: References establish literature context and current audited boundaries. They do not certify novelty, truth, or completeness of the search.
